verdict.rationale: The evidence shows category, cost-center and receipt-linking APIs, plus configurable auto-categorization and AI-driven spend alerts and insights by channel. None of this documents AI reading receipts, suggesting categories or memos, or detecting duplicates or fraud. The AI insights are a related spend-analytics feature, and the APIs are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI codes and audits expenses for me — reading receipts, suggesting categories and memos, and catching duplicates or fraud
